lines.text: Lakers courtside costs at least four grand. Per seat. Per night.
Your sneakers on the baseline. Celebrities one chair over.
A regular-season night: four to ten thousand dollars a seat.
Forty-one home games, at the cheapest: a hundred sixty-four grand.
Make the playoffs, and one seat jumps to twenty to forty grand.
Even the Lakers' new Courtside Reserve seats: fifteen to thirty grand.
Two seats, every home game, cheapest nights: about three hundred thirty grand.
Before a single playoff game. Would you sit courtside?
